headline: Profit and revenue growth accelerate sharply year over year
summary_short: Nu Holdings' Q1 FY2026 revenue rose 57.2% y/y to $3,538.3 million and net income grew 56.5% y/y to $872.1 million, though net income slipped 2.3% q/q even as revenue grew 12.8% q/q.
summary_long: Q1 FY2026 revenue reached $3,538.3 million, up 57.2% y/y and 12.8% q/q. Net income of $872.1 million rose 56.5% y/y but fell 2.3% q/q. Diluted EPS was $0.18 (+55.9% y/y) and basic EPS was $0.18 (+55.2% y/y), tracking net income growth closely. No cash-position KPI is present on the shard to assess balance-sheet delta.
